item.title: Google Broke reCAPTCHA for De-Googled Android Users
item.description:
📝 That scan requires Play Services running in the background, communicating with Google’s servers. Google didn’t demand iPhone users install Google software to pass the test. When Google ties verification to Play Services, it establishes a precedent where accessing basic web content requires running Google’s software and transmitting data to Google’s servers.
🔗 Read more: https://reclaimthenet.org/google-broke-recaptcha-for-de-googled-android-users
